news.body:
## The money is yours and Tuesday is close
- SBI put the first tranche into your savings account yesterday.
It lines up with the October instalment, so the bank is out of the way and what is left is a transfer you make and the mail to Marie Rose. The 24th is Tuesday, class runs to seven tonight and Thursday and Friday, and a transfer that size is not same-day.
## Liesbeth is waiting on your Career Anchors
- Dated Monday the 23rd, marked quick, and never opened.
Monday is the far side of a weekend with two class days in front of it, so tonight is the cheapest this will ever be.
## Two things are actually late
- Club 8 has not moved since the 9th, the longest-standing late item you have.
What the room comes with and when you can take the keys are both still open, and both are one email.
- Harver is two days past its date and has never been opened.
Kraft Heinz cannot see your results until it is in, and nothing is forcing it.
